# Setup

```{r}
renv::load()
source("./results/utils.R")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(CAdir)
  library(APL)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(dplyr)

  library(scater)
  library(scuttle)
  library(scran)

  library(patchwork)
  library(ggtext)
})

options(repr.plot.width = 20, repr.plot.height = 15)

dir <- "./results/"
imgdir <- file.path(dir, "img/review/sm_plots/")
dir.create(imgdir, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load parameters
```{r}
date <- "20250528_cpu"
evldir <- file.path("./results/benchmarking/results/real/", date, "eval")

options(repr.plot.width = 15, repr.plot.height = 10)
```
```{r}
### Load the results of real data sets
files <- list.files(evldir, "*.rds", full.names = TRUE)

df <- data.frame()
for (file in files) {
  data <- readRDS(file)
  df <- bind_rows(df, data)
}

df$dataset <- gsub("_filtered", "", df$dataset)
```

```{r}
df$dataset[df$dataset == "FreytagGold"] <- "Freytag Gold"
df$dataset[df$dataset == "PBMC_10X"] <- "PBMC10x"
df$dataset[df$dataset == "Tirosh_nonmaglignant"] <- "Tirosh"
df$dataset[df$dataset == "ZeiselBrain"] <- "Zeisel"
df$dataset[df$dataset == "BaronPancreas"] <- "Baron Pancreas"
df$dataset[df$dataset == "dmel_E14-16h"] <- "Dmel Spatial"
df$dataset[df$dataset == "tabula_sapiens_tissue"] <- "Tabula Sapiens"
df$dataset[df$dataset == "brain_organoids"] <- "Brain Organoids"

df <- df %>%
  mutate(algorithm = gsub("CAbiNet_igraph", "CAbiNet", algorithm)) %>%
  mutate(pattern = paste0(algorithm, dataset))
```

```{r}
# Filter out combinations where all runs fail.
test <- df %>%
  group_by(dataset, algorithm) %>%
  mutate(fail.n = sum(is.na(ARI)), scsd.n = n()) %>%
  filter(fail.n == scsd.n | (scsd.n == 0))

## pick 1 algor./dataset combinaton of failed runs
df_na <- test %>%
  group_by(algorithm, dataset) %>%
  arrange(runtime) %>%
  select(-fail.n, -scsd.n) %>%
  top_n(n = 1, wt = runtime)
```

```{r}
# Filter out runs which failed
subdf <- df[!(df$pattern %in% test$pattern), ]
subdf <- subdf[!is.na(subdf$ARI), ]
subdf <- rbind(subdf, df_na) # add a single instance of failed runs & missing runs.

subdf$algorithm <- factor(
  subdf$algorithm,
  levels = c(
    "CAdir",
    "CAdir_auto",
    "kmeans",
    "CAbiNet",
    "RaceID",
    "RaceID_auto",
    "Seurat",
    "Monocle3",
    "SC3",
    "SIMLR",
    "scDeepCluster",
    "scG-cluster"
  )
)

df_g <- subdf %>%
  group_by(algorithm, dataset) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_ARI = mean(ARI),
    Max_ARI = max(ARI),
    Median_ARI = median(ARI),
    Mean_NMI = mean(NMI),
    Max_NMI = max(NMI)
  )

df_g$dataset <- factor(
  df_g$dataset,
  levels = c(
    "Darmanis",
    "Freytag Gold",
    "PBMC10x",
    "Tirosh",
    "Zeisel",
    "Baron Pancreas",
    "Dmel Spatial",
    "Tabula Sapiens",
    "Brain Organoids"
  )
)
```

```{r}
df_m <- df_g %>%
  group_by(sim, algorithm, dataset) %>%
  mutate(max_NMI = max(NMI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(max_ARI = max(ARI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  # select(dataset, sim, algorithm, max_NMI, max_ARI) %>%
  filter(ARI == max_ARI) %>%
  distinct(dataset, sim, algorithm, max_NMI, max_ARI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

df_m$max_NMI[is.infinite(df_m$max_NMI)] <- NA
df_m$max_ARI[is.infinite(df_m$max_ARI)] <- NA
```
# Tirosh

## Load data set

```{r}

file <- "./data/real/preprocessed/benchmarking/Tirosh_nonmaglignant_filtered.rds"
tirosh <- readRDS(file)
```


# Run clustering - Tirosh

```{r}
dft <- df_m %>%
  filter(dataset == "Tirosh") %>%
  filter(algorithm == "CAdir_auto") %>%
  select(
    algorithm,
    dataset,
    ARI,
    max_ARI,
    ntop,
    ngenes,
    dims,
    kdir,
    angle,
    qcut,
    apl_quant
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(2358)
genevars <- scran::modelGeneVar(tirosh, assay.type = "logcounts")
chosen <- scran::getTopHVGs(genevars, n = dft$ntop, var.threshold = NULL)
tirosh <- tirosh[chosen, ]

cnts <- as.matrix(logcounts(tirosh))

caobj <- cacomp(cnts, dims = dft$dims, top = nrow(cnts), python = TRUE)

angle <- as.numeric(dft$angle)
if (angle == 0) {
  angle <- NULL
}
cadir <- dirclust_splitmerge(
  caobj = caobj,
  k = dft$kdir,
  cutoff = angle,
  method = "random",
  apl_quant = dft$apl_quant,
  qcutoff = dft$qcut,
  counts = NULL,
  min_cells = 20,
  reps = 5,
  make_plots = FALSE
)

cadir

tirosh$cadir <- cadir@cell_clusters
aricode::ARI(tirosh$truth, tirosh$cadir)
```
## UMAP
```{r}
um1 <- plotUMAP(tirosh, colour = "cadir")
um2 <- plotUMAP(tirosh, colour = "truth")

um1 + um2
```

## SM plot
```{r}

sm <- sm_plot(
  cadir = cadir,
  caobj = caobj,
  rm_redund = TRUE,
  keep_end = FALSE,
  highlight_cluster = TRUE,
  show_genes = FALSE,
  annotate_clusters = TRUE,
  org = "hs",
  inlet_side = 0.11,
  title_size = 12,
  show_axis = FALSE,
  layout = "tree",
  rotate = FALSE
)
```

# Brain organoids

## Load data set
```{r}

file <- "./data/real/preprocessed/benchmarking/brain_organoids_filtered.rds"
brain <- readRDS(file)
```

# Run clustering - Brain Organoids

```{r}
dft <- df_m %>%
  filter(dataset == "Brain Organoids") %>%
  filter(algorithm == "CAdir_auto") %>%
  select(
    algorithm,
    dataset,
    ARI,
    max_ARI,
    ntop,
    ngenes,
    dims,
    kdir,
    angle,
    qcut,
    apl_quant
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(2358)
genevars <- scran::modelGeneVar(brain, assay.type = "logcounts")
chosen <- scran::getTopHVGs(genevars, n = dft$ntop, var.threshold = NULL)
brain <- brain[chosen, ]

cnts <- as.matrix(logcounts(brain))

caobj <- cacomp(cnts, dims = dft$dims, top = nrow(cnts), python = TRUE)

angle <- as.numeric(dft$angle)
if (angle == 0) {
  angle <- NULL
}
cadir <- dirclust_splitmerge(
  caobj = caobj,
  k = dft$kdir,
  cutoff = angle,
  method = "random",
  apl_quant = dft$apl_quant,
  qcutoff = dft$qcut,
  counts = NULL,
  min_cells = 20,
  reps = 5,
  make_plots = FALSE
)

cadir

brain$cadir <- cadir@cell_clusters
aricode::ARI(brain$truth, brain$cadir)
```
## UMAP
```{r}
um1 <- plotUMAP(brain, colour = "cadir")
um2 <- plotUMAP(brain, colour = "truth")

um1 + um2
```

## SM plot
```{r}

sm <- sm_plot(
  cadir = cadir,
  caobj = caobj,
  rm_redund = TRUE,
  keep_end = FALSE,
  highlight_cluster = TRUE,
  show_genes = FALSE,
  annotate_clusters = TRUE,
  org = "hs",
  inlet_side = 0.11,
  title_size = 12,
  show_axis = FALSE,
  layout = "tree",
  rotate = FALSE
)
```
